text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Heliooos, hbd! Your celebration's gonna be 
birthday nails~♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
From me, here's some of this spring's new 
makeup. You looked pretty interested when 
you were flipping through that magazine 
earlier.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real?! Seriously?! That is insanely 
sick!! Is that every ounce of cuteness 
packed in one?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"For now, how's this look? Making it 
gorgeous with jewelry parts~♪"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-haaa☆ Isn't this incredible? Calling 
these "parts" is an understatement—they're 
practically jewelry!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Then, how about this one? To match your 
hairstyle, with pink and rose tones—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Omg... this is adorbs... my heart skipped 
a beat. This totally wins the Most Beloved 
Heli-pi Award...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Omigosh... This makes me the ultimate, 
invincible, GI Gyaru Helipoyo...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaah... Seriously, thaaanks! Gals truly 
are the absolute best~~!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...That's what they said. Gotta fire 
myself up.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, now I'm fired up! Leave it all to 
us♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Jordan, City... I wuv you guys sooo 
much~~!!
